title: Determine the Area of Triangles
focus: Use base and height for triangle area

items.stem: What is the formula to find the area of a triangle?
A triangle has a base of 8 cm and a height of 5 cm. What is the area of the triangle?
Select ALL the true statements about the base and height of a triangle.
choices: The height is always the longest side of a triangle.
The height is the perpendicular distance from the base to the opposite vertex.
The base can be any side of the triangle.
The height must be drawn inside the triangle for all triangles.

items.stem: A triangle has a base of 10 inches and a height of 7 inches. Calculate the area of the triangle and explain how you found your answer. Show or explain your work.
